# Animation dependencies

Self-hosted to avoid an external CDN request blocking portfolio startup.
Downloaded 2026-09-09 from the pinned package URLs below; original bundle
copyright/license banners are retained.

- GSAP 3.12.5: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.12.5/dist/gsap.min.js
- ScrollTrigger 3.12.5: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.12.5/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js
- Lenis 1.1.14: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lenis@1.1.14/dist/lenis.min.js

GSAP's 3.12.5 package metadata identifies its license as the Standard
"no charge" license: https://gsap.com/standard-license . It is not MIT.
